articles.title: Space Telescope Finds a Baby Galaxy Made of Almost Nothing But Hydrogen!
articles.summary: Imagine a galaxy so old it barely has any metal—like a cosmic baby picture! The James Webb telescope spotted LAP1-B, a tiny, faint galaxy from 800 million years after the Big Bang. It has 240 times less oxygen than our sun.

articles.title: This Spooky Space Bubble Shows What Will Happen to Our Sun—in 5 Billion Years!
articles.summary: Gaze into the Crystal Ball Nebula! This glowing cloud, 1,500 light-years away, is a peek at our sun's future. When stars like our sun die, they puff out gorgeous gas shells. The nebula's center hides a dancing pair of dead stars.

articles.title: A 4,000-Year-Old Skull Shows a Kid Had Brain Surgery—and It's the Oldest in Central Asia!
articles.summary: Archaeologists in Uzbekistan found the skull of a 5-year-old from the Bronze Age with a hole cut into it. This is the oldest evidence of surgery in Central Asia! The child lived 4,000 years ago in a bustling ancient town called Djarkutan.
